title: VP of Information Technology
description_md: Cascade Regional Health, a 6-hospital nonprofit system, seeks a VP of IT to own infrastructure, security, and the EHR vendor relationship for a $1.2B system. Reports to the CFO; a seat on the executive operations committee. Prior healthcare IT leadership strongly preferred; HIPAA and EHR migration experience required.

title: Director of IT
description_md: Alderbrook Manufacturing Group (1,800 employees, 4 plants) is hiring a Director of IT to modernize its ERP and OT/IT convergence program. Direct P&L ownership of a $6M budget and a team of 14. Hybrid, 2 days/week at the Ohio headquarters.

title: Head of Technology
description_md: Brightwater Financial Services, a regional wealth-management firm, seeks a Head of Technology to lead a 20-person engineering and infrastructure org through a core-banking platform replacement. Full remote, quarterly on-site leadership offsites.

title: VP Engineering & IT
description_md: Norwood Retail Holdings (140 stores) is hiring a VP of Engineering & IT to unify a fragmented POS and inventory stack across three acquired chains. Onsite at the Denver support center; direct report to the COO.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description_md: Fernbridge Logistics, a mid-market freight brokerage backed by a growth equity sponsor, is hiring its first CTO to build a real-time load-matching platform and a 25-person engineering team ahead of a planned exit in 3-4 years.

title: Director of Information Technology
description_md: Silverpine Insurance seeks a Director of IT to run claims-system uptime and a mid-size infrastructure team. Stable, steady-state operation; limited transformation scope described in the posting.

title: VP of IT Operations
description_md: Kettleford Manufacturing needs a VP of IT Operations to keep plant-floor systems running and manage a help-desk team of 6. Mostly run-the-business scope; onsite 5 days at the Indiana plant.

title: Head of IT & Security
description_md: Bluecrest Credit Union is hiring a Head of IT & Security to lead a compact team through an NCUA exam remediation. Well-scoped compliance work, modest budget authority, fully remote within the credit union's home state.

title: Director, Enterprise Technology
description_md: Marrow Bay Hospital System is hiring a Director of Enterprise Technology to co-lead (with a VP) a multi-year Epic rollout. Good scope and comp, but the role reports two levels below the CIO with limited independent authority.

title: VP of Digital & IT
description_md: Thornfield Apparel, a mid-size DTC clothing brand, seeks a VP of Digital & IT to oversee e-commerce platform reliability and a small internal-tools team. Scope is narrower than the title implies; genuinely borderline.

title: IT Director
description_md: Rennick County Government is hiring an IT Director to run county-wide systems for 900 employees across 12 departments. Public-sector pace and process; steady, well-defined scope with civil-service constraints on team changes.

title: Head of Infrastructure & IT
description_md: Oakmere University seeks a Head of Infrastructure & IT to modernize campus network and identity systems ahead of a new research-computing initiative. Strong scope and visibility for a university role, just under the bar for the strongest applies.

title: IT Director
description_md: Pratt Family Dental Group (4 clinics, 60 employees) is hiring an 'IT Director' whose actual scope is desktop support and a shared practice-management system. Title inflation over a working-manager job.

title: Director of IT
description_md: Wrenfield Analytics is a 5-person pre-seed startup posting a 'Director of IT' role that is really a solo IT-generalist hire with no team, no defined budget, and no posted compensation.

title: VP of IT
description_md: A generic 'VP of IT' requisition posted by a staffing agency on behalf of an undisclosed client, reposted verbatim across a dozen boards with no company detail, no comp range, and no way to identify the actual employer. Ghost-posting profile.

title: Head of IT
description_md: Coldharbor Nonprofit Trust seeks a 'Head of IT' at a nonprofit-scale salary well below market for the seniority implied, effectively a sole IT support hire with a senior title.

title: Director, IT Help Desk Operations
description_md: Ashgrove Retail Chain's 'Director' role is scoped entirely to tier-1/tier-2 help-desk ticket queues with no infrastructure, security, or vendor ownership. Misleading title for a working supervisor job.

title: VP of Information Technology
description_md: Bannerworth Casino Group's VP of IT role has strong scope and comp, but requires full relocation to an onsite gaming-floor location with no remote or hybrid option under any circumstance; a geographic dealbreaker rather than a quality problem.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description_md: Vellum Robotics is a pre-seed, pre-revenue robotics startup offering a CTO title with equity only, no cash salary, and no committed runway beyond six months. High risk with no compensating comp floor.

title: Director of IT
description_md: A second Ashgrove Retail Chain posting, reposted with an identical description six times over two months under different requisition numbers -- a hallmark ghost-job pattern with generic corporate boilerplate and no real hiring urgency.
